Counter.description: Nonnegative decimal counter, at most 19 digits. String on JSON to preserve precision in JavaScript; compare numerically.

Bytes.description: Canonical padded base64. Decoded size and negotiated transport budget also enforced.

SignedValue.description: Signed fixed-point integer string; metric definition supplies scale. No floating-point ranking.

recording.description: Terminal manifest; semantic and conditional schema checks enforce final state.
